newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Sam Yang, Orient shrs plunge.
newsitem.headline: Sam Yang, Orient shrs plunge.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Sam Yang Foods Co and Orient Co plunged on Wednesday on news that the Securities Supervisory Board had found instances of illegal share price manipulation, brokers said.
Sam Yang shares were down 2,200 won to their lower limit of 34,800, while Orient was down 800 won to 42,800 after touching its lower limit of 41,000 won.
The SSB said it found that an investor repeatedly placed high bids on Sam Yang's shares to push the share price higher.
It added that a brokerage firm employee illegally used customers' accounts to manipulate Orient's shares. It did not identify the two people.

"This news will have a bad effect on individual shares that have risen rapidly over the past several months, because investors will be wondering who will be the next target (of a manipulation probe)," said Hur Gyung-shik of Samsung Securities.
